headline: Chris Evans Helps Bonded Shelter Dogs Find Home Together
meta_description: Actor Chris Evans featured two inseparable shelter dogs in a 'Dream Date' video, leading to their adoption by the same family.
summary_short: Two shelter dogs who couldn't be separated found their forever home together after Chris Evans helped showcase their story.
body:
Two shelter dogs named Greg and Carly, bonded so closely they couldn't be separated, have found a home together thanks to actor Chris Evans.

Evans featured the pair in a "Dream Date" video, a format designed to help shelter animals find adoptive families. The exposure proved effective—a single family saw the video and decided to adopt both dogs, keeping the inseparable pair together.

The outcome highlights how creative advocacy can transform shelter animals' lives. By giving Greg and Carly a platform, Evans helped ensure they wouldn't face the heartbreak of separation, a common challenge when bonded animals enter the shelter system. Their story reminds us that sometimes the best homes are waiting—they just need the right introduction.
quick_facts: Two shelter dogs named Greg and Carly stayed together
Chris Evans created a 'Dream Date' video to help them
One family adopted both dogs after seeing the video
